title: One non-blocking line reader for Hyprland events and channel clients
body:
`viewer.rs` has a 40-line calloop closure that reads the Hyprland event socket in `[0u8; 4096]` chunks, handles `Ok(0)` and `WouldBlock`, and drains lines at `position(b'\n')` before calling `hypr::wants_recount`. The channel client reader in `compositor.rs` is the same loop over socket lines. `read_lines` in `decade-channel` is a blocking cousin. `hypr.rs` owns the event format and `events()` but not the reading.

## Proposal

One line reader shared by both, with `hypr.rs` owning the Hyprland read and `viewer.rs` keeping only `recount_alone`.
